info.title: Stocked API
info.description: REST API for managing a personal food inventory: authentication, foods, and food items.

get.description: Returns a static status payload. Does not touch the database or require authentication.
Returns the profile of the user identified by the JWT supplied in the Authorization header.

401.description: Missing, malformed, or invalid access token

404.description: The user referenced by the token no longer exists

get.description: Returns globally available foods plus the foods created by the authenticated user.

get.summary: List the authenticated user food items
get.description: Returns the food items owned by the authenticated user, optionally filtered by name, category, and expiry date, and sorted by expiry date.

parameters.name: contains
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the food name

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Only return items whose food is in one of these categories

parameters.name: expiryDate
parameters.description: Only return items whose expiry date is on or before this ISO 8601 timestamp

200.description: Food items owned by the authenticated user

unit.description: Unit the quantity is expressed in

expiryDate.description: Expiry timestamp (ISO 8601) or null when it does not expire

createdByUserId.description: Owner user id, or null for a globally available food

401.description: Missing, malformed, or invalid access token
